chains.title: NKRF binds the ref allele more strongly and may relieve TERT repression if NKRF is a repressor
chains.element: The variant is annotated in ENSR5_C5GP and lies 75 bp from the nearest active pELS/PLS in ENCODE SCREEN, but no cCRE overlaps the variant itself; this is a regulatory neighborhood, not a demonstrated glioblastoma-specific active element.

links.claim: NKRF is the best occupied/expressed QBiC-SELEX candidate for a ref>alt effect: its own model gives z -12.31 and effect -0.514, so ref G binds more strongly in vitro. NKRF is expressed in DepMap glioblastoma, but ENCODE ChIP-seq over this variant is only in GM12878, and E35 reports no NKRF glioblastoma peak; glioblastoma occupancy is therefore not demonstrated. NKRF was chosen over other occupied TFs because it has an own-model QBiC-SELEX change above the gate and a ref-more direction, but this is weak without matching occupancy.

The variant is in an ENSR5_C5GP enhancer annotation and near active ENCODE pELS/PLS elements, so it could alter a TERT regulatory element. However, no cCRE overlaps the variant and the cCRE z-scores are maxima over biosamples, not glioblastoma-specific.

TERT is the nearest protein-coding gene, 0.5 kb from the TSS, and Open Targets L2G assigns TERT 0.84 in the only credible set. Caveat: that credible set has PIP 0.00 and is for hypertension, not the case diseases.

NKRF is expressed in DepMap glioblastoma lines, but E04 states no ENCODE biosample matches the expression context and E35 reports no NKRF glioblastoma peak over the variant. Occupancy in the relevant cell type is inferred, not shown.

TERT is broadly implicated in glioblastoma, melanoma, and bladder cancer, but there is no variant-specific GWAS association or GTEx eQTL for rs34768248. If NKRF represses TERT and the alt allele weakens NKRF binding, TERT activity could increase, but the NKRF-TERT repression axis is not demonstrated here.

predictions: In heterozygous glioblastoma cells, NKRF ChIP signal at rs34768248 is higher on the ref G allele than the alt A allele.
If NKRF represses TERT, NKRF knockdown increases TERT expression and the alt allele partially phenocopies NKRF loss by reducing repression.
NKRF occupancy at this element should track TERT expression in a glioblastoma model.
falsified_if: Allele-specific NKRF ChIP in a heterozygous glioblastoma line shows no ref>alt occupancy difference at rs34768248.
NKRF knockdown does not change TERT expression or does not modify the allelic effect in a glioblastoma model.
